value_cards_1.title: White-label
value_cards_1.body: Ship it under your own brand — every client-facing page, email and CMS login carries your name, not ours.
bullets: No Three Acts branding on any client-facing page
Your logo and domain on the CMS login

value_cards_1.title: Agency licence
value_cards_1.body: One licence covers unlimited client sites — no per-site fee, ever, and it pays for itself after two or three builds for most studios.
bullets: Unlimited client sites under one licence
Upgrade to Unlimited any time for the price difference

value_cards_1.title: Partner support
value_cards_1.body: A direct line to the people who build the template, for the questions a support ticket can't answer.
bullets: Priority email support, one working day reply

steps_2.title: Apply for an agency licence
steps_2.description: Tell us about your studio and the kind of client work you do through the form below. We reply within two working days.

steps_2.title: Get repo access
steps_2.description: We add you to the private GitHub repo under the agency licence — clone it for every client project from there.

steps_2.title: Fork per client
steps_2.description: Rename the brand, configure the registry, and ship — the same steps as the docs, once per client site.

steps_2.title: Lean on partner support
steps_2.description: Email us when something's non-standard for a client build. We reply within one working day.

agencies.title_4: Build client sites on Three Acts
agencies.lede_5: An agency licence covers unlimited client sites under your own brand, with a direct line to the people who build the template.
